title: U.S. Surgeon General's Report on Smoking
description: On January 11, 1964, U.S. Surgeon General Luther Terry released a landmark report definitively linking cigarette smoking to lung cancer, heart disease, and other serious health conditions. The 387-page document, based on over 7,000 scientific studies, concluded that smoking was a major health hazard. This groundbreaking report led to warning labels on cigarette packages, advertising restrictions, and public health campaigns that dramatically reduced smoking rates. It marked a turning point in public health policy and saved millions of lives.
